name: verbative-speak
description: Claude Code speaks: a short summary when a task finishes, and what it needs when it waits for you: an approval, an answer, or a plan to review. Natural on-device voice, no API key. Free for 10 summaries a day.

voice.title: Voice
voice.description: Who reads Claude's summaries aloud. American: Heart, Bella, Sarah, Nicole, Sky (female), Adam, Michael (male). British: Emma, Isabella (female), George, Lewis (male).

speed.title: Speed
speed.description: How fast it speaks: 1.0 is normal, 1.3 is the default.

summary.title: When a task finishes
summary.description: summary: read Claude's short summary aloud. done: just say “Done.”

approvals.title: Approval reminders
approvals.description: Say what Claude is waiting for when it needs you: an approval, an answer, or a plan to review.
